notes: Technical report (pilot safety-only). No dedicated safety, alignment, jailbreak, toxicity, bias, or dangerous-capability evaluation tables or numeric results. Skipped all capability benchmarks (MMLU-Redux/Pro, GPQA-Diamond, AIME 2025, HMMT Feb 2025, LiveCodeBench v5/v6, IFEval, Multi-IF, HELMET, RULER, LongBench, BFCL-v3, Tau-Bench, KMMLU-Pro/Redux, MMMLU ES, WMT24++, Ko-LongBench, reasoning-budget ablations).
